_comment: Questions asked of the real chat pipeline by scripts/demo/generate_demo_conversations.py. Replace each REPLACE-* item id with the shipped bundle's item ids (the ids of the collection's files); a question is asked in its own conversation, followed by its follow-ups. Cross-file questions list several items.

conversations.title: How do the news reports differ across languages?
questions: Summarize each news report in two sentences, and say which language it was in.
Which report gives the most detail about its main event, and what did the reporter say about it?

conversations.title: What did the commission decide, and what did the chair say about it?
questions: What decisions or votes were taken in these meetings, and who proposed each?
What did the chair say about the main item on the agenda?

conversations.title: What did the Chair say about inflation and rates?
questions: What did the Chair say about inflation, and how did that change between the two recordings?
Summarize the reasons given for the latest policy decision.

conversations.title: What are the key safety and preparedness steps?
questions: List the main steps each training video tells a viewer to take.
What did the instructor say about the most common mistake?

conversations.title: What did the scientists say about the mission or the forecast?
questions: Summarize the briefing in five bullet points.
What did the speakers say about risks or uncertainty, and who said it?

conversations.title: What personal details were in the clip?
questions: What kinds of personal information appear in this recording, and how are they shown to a viewer?
